faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about ProductName.

q1.question: Can I try before I buy?
q1.answer: Absolutely! We offer a 14-day free trial on all plans — no credit card required.

q2.question: How does billing work?
q2.answer: Choose monthly or annual billing (save 20% annually). Cancel anytime with no penalties.

q3.question: Is my data secure?
q3.answer: Yes. We use AES-256 encryption, are fully GDPR/SOC2 compliant, and perform daily backups.

q4.question: Can I migrate data from another platform?
q4.answer: Yes, we offer free assisted migration. Our team handles everything for you.

q5.question: Do you offer startup discounts?
q5.answer: Yes! Early-stage startups can apply for our program with 50% off the first year.

q6.question: What's your support response time?
q6.answer: Starter: 24 hours. Pro: 4 hours. Enterprise: 1 hour with a dedicated account manager.
